texts.preamble: Sampat Bhagwan Nanawanre vs The State Of Maharashtra on 9 February, 2022 Author: C.V. Bhadang Bench: C.V. Bhadang 20- In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction Cri. Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2622 Of 2021 Sampat Bhagwan Nanaware ..Applicant Vs. The State of Maharashtra ..Respondent ---- Mr. Vikas B. Shivarkar, for the Applicant. Mr. R. M. Pethe, App for the Respondent / State. Digitally signed Mamta by Mamta ---- Amar Kale Amar Date: Kale 2022.02.09 18:07:24 +0530 Coram : C.V. Bhadang, J. Date : 9 February 2022 (Through Video Conferencing) P.C. .
texts.facts: The allegation as per FIR is that there was adulteration of the milk by addition of Nirma Powder and other detergents. In so far as the present Applicant is concerned, he is only the driver on the vehicle in which the milk was being transported. It appears that there was a transport contract between the employer of the present Applicant and the company for transport of the milk.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned Counsel for the Applicant submitted that the Applicant is not even an employee of the main Accused who are alleged to have committed adulteration of the milk. 5. Learned APP, in all fairness, did not dispute that the only role of the Applicant is that he was a driver on the vehicle and in spite of knowledge, he did not report the matter of adulteration to the authorities.
